metadata.label: Enterprises (FDB) by industrial classification SNI 2007 and size class. Year 2008-2025
note: The statistics includes all legal and physical persons registered for VAT, for preliminary tax for entrepreneurs or as an employer. This means that the number of units may differ from statistics of number of units originating from other sources that aims to describe another population. For official statistics of the number of units engaged in farm activities, as well as the number of schools, please see statistics from the Swedish Board of Agriculture and the Swedish National Agency for Education respectively.
